name: resend
description: Full Resend email platform via the official resend-mcp server — send transactional and marketing email, manage contacts / segments / topics / custom properties, run broadcast campaigns, configure sender domains, API keys, and webhooks, and read inbound email.

interface.shortDescription: Send email and run campaigns via the official Resend MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can handle all your email needs through Resend — sending transactional emails, managing contacts, running broadcast campaigns, and configuring sender domains. From password resets to newsletter campaigns, your agent can draft, send, and track everything through conversation. No more logging into the Resend dashboard for every send or campaign update.
defaultPrompt: Send a transactional email to this address with the following content.
Show me my recent email analytics and delivery stats.
Help me create a broadcast campaign for my contacts.
